_comment: Artifact pins in the signed public/api/identity.json that were ALREADY broken when scripts/check-identity-pins.sh was introduced (2026-08-06). This file is an acknowledgement list, not a mute button: a tracked-class entry suppresses the gate only while BOTH pinned_sha256 and observed_sha256 still hold. Re-sign the manifest or edit the artifact again and the entry stops applying, so the break is reported as new. Stream-class entries are documentation only - they never gate anything, because a push-owned feed is rewritten by host cron on its own cadence and its pin is stale by construction. Every entry here is a C4 (stop pinning moving streams / re-issue on artifact change) work item.

recorded_against.identity_signed_by_commit: 7dd2eb6 (re-signed 2026-08-06; both tracked-class entries resolved by that re-issue)
recorded_against.measurement: tracked-class observed_sha256 measured against the repo working tree; stream-class observed_sha256 measured against the live published URL at record time (a moving value, informational only)

evidence_json.sha256.reason: Push-owned feed (deploy/feed-excludes.txt): regenerated by host cron via scripts/gen-evidence.sh, so any pin is stale within one cron period. Structural, not a regression.
evidence_json.sha256.resolution: C4 - stop pinning moving streams in the signed manifest (pin the schema, not the payload; or move the payload digest to the timestamped anchor-source snapshot, which is honest about being point-in-time).

validator_json.sha256.reason: Push-owned feed (deploy/feed-excludes.txt): rewritten by scripts/node-info.sh from live metalgo RPC. Observed to change twice within a single 20-minute measurement window on 2026-08-06, which is the clearest possible demonstration that a signed pin cannot track it.

uptime_cycles_json.sha256.reason: Push-owned feed (deploy/feed-excludes.txt): appended by scripts/uptime-history.sh as cycles accumulate.
